title: A refined multiplication formula in 2-Calabi-Yau Frobenius extriangulated categories
summary: We prove a multiplication formula for the Wang-Wei-Zhang cluster character on a Hom-finite $2$-Calabi--Yau Frobenius extriangulated category $\mathcal C$ with a cluster-tilting object under the assumption that its stable category has constructible cones with respect to the induced cluster-tilting object. This formula generalizes those obtained by Wang-Wei-Zhang for $\mathcal C$ in the one-dimensional case and by Keller-Plamondon-Qin for (stably) $2$-Calabi-Yau Frobenius or triangulated categories.
